title: A role with all permissions on behaves like Administrator but is still a custom role
custom_preconds:
1. A custom role 'Max Permissions' has every box and toggle on.
  2. A user is assigned that role.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Check access to every navigation item, sidebar group and settings page.
  3. Do an add/edit/delete on a work order, customer, invoice, part sale and vendor.
  4. Open the See Financial Data areas.
  5. View AP/AR data and customer credit fields.
  6. Open history.
  7. Open Roles & Permissions.
custom_expected:
Everything works — the same as Administrator.

The user can open Roles & Permissions if App Settings is on, but the role itself is a custom role (editable and deletable) and the user cannot grant themselves anything the role does not already include.
evidence: UI: an all-permissions custom role (42 perms, all cross-toggles on, type Custom) behaves like Administrator — full nav (Work Orders/Schedule/Customers/Parts/Reports), /reports and /administration/staff accessible — yet it is a Custom role (created via Create Custom Role). screenshot xperm-AllOn.
